  • 1. Please wipe with a damp cloth or alcohol.
  • 2. Do not place open flames (e.g. candles) on the product!
  • 3. Since it is a brand new product, it will smell like raw materials in a short time.If you have something against it, please put it in a ventilated place for about a week, and the smell will be relieved.

Descriptions

DESCRIPTION

This chest of drawers should not be missing in any apartment. Durable and expressive wood in soft off-white creates a cosy and warm living area. MORE STORAGE - The sideboard consists of 2 wooden doors and 3 drawers. So storage is taken care of! Easy assembly - Thanks to the detailed instructions, the wooden chest of drawers can be set up quickly and easily and is therefore also suitable for beginners. Installation material included. Dimensions: 120 x 82.5 x 40 cm (W/H/D). Rattan Fabric Door Panel: It is beautiful and stylish, prevents dust from entering, and makes daily cleaning easier. High-quality materials: Certified E1 chipboard keeps you away from chemical odors. The thicker version of the board is matched with solid pine wood legs, which significantly increases the stability of the product, and the properly assembled cabinet will not wobble. 45 Degree Splicing: The corners are spliced at 45 degrees, so the cream cabinet is matched with woven PE rattan, which enhances the shape and design of the product. No hinge: The door panels are designed to be very easy to install while reducing noise. Scope of delivery - Scope of delivery: 1 sideboard/chest of drawers, metal handle and mounting hardware. This product is packed in two boxes. You can get it on different days. This sideboard will look great in your living room or dining room and is available in a cream color. 2 wooden doors and 3 drawers provide plenty of space to store dishes, boxes, and more. All surfaces are waterproof and easy to clean. Self-assembly is required, and the box includes illustrated instructions and a screw pack. Product Size: Strong and durable, suitable for daily use
